title: What do plants need?
card: A fair test with three seeds.

predict.prompt: Three seeds get the same soil and pots. One gets light and water, one is kept in the dark, one gets no water. Which will grow into a healthy green plant?

try: Tap each pot to plant its seed. Then come back after two game days (two turns of the sun) to see what grew.
result: With light and water, the seed grew into a green, healthy plant. In the dark, it grew a thin, pale yellow shoot. With no water, the seed did not sprout at all.
why: This was a fair test: the seeds had the same soil and the same pots, and only one thing changed each time. That way we know what made the difference.
Seeds need water to sprout. A seed carries a little food of its own, so it can start growing in the dark, but the shoot grows pale and thin, stretching to find light.
Green plants need light to make their own food from air and water. Real seeds take days or weeks to sprout: the Lab's seeds are extra quick!
